text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Work starts in southern city of Sfax to demolish former chemical plant that was poisoning coastal environment.
- Mediterranean Tourism Exhibit opens with more than 150 participants from Tunisia and abroad.
- Some 500 firms expected to attend forum on exports to be chaired by Prime Minister Karoui on May 13 in Tunis.
- New local tax code completes government's reforms adopted during last 10 years in fiscal sector.
